newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo aluminium futures ended lower across the board on Thursday, as the yen's gains against the dollar accelerated selling orders from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.0 to 5.1 yen lower, with the benchmark June 1998 contract down 4.7 yen at 198.0 yen per kg.
The yen's advances against the dollar triggered heavy selling from local investors from the opening, traders said. "Selling orders were accelerated by early afternoon," a brokerage house trader said.
